We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule (which is protected with TBS) reproduces the reaction: removal of TBS to give free alcohol (aliphatic hydroxyl). So forward reaction: protected alcohol (with TBS) -> free alcohol, breaking O-Si bond, forming OH. So we need to search template catalog with functional_groups_broken: maybe "t-butyldimethylsilyl" (the protecting group) and functional_groups_formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls". Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

We have target molecule: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

But this SMILES seems to have no TBS group? Wait it's an alcohol maybe not protected. Actually the description says TBS group is removed, but the given molecule maybe the product (free alcohol). The retrosynthetic step would add TBS protecting group to give precursor. So we need template that does protection (forward reaction is deprotection). The template likely matches O-Si bond broken.

We need to search with functional_groups_broken: ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"]? Or maybe "t-butyldimethylsilyl" is the group removed. functional_groups_formed: ["aliphatic hydroxyls"].

Let's call get_available_functional_groups to see names.
